overview.description: The Northern Trust Morningstar US Market Factor Tilt ETF (TILT) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Morningstar US Market Factor Tilt index. The fund tracks a broad US index with a tilt toward small-cap and value segments. TILT was launched on Sep 16, 2011 and is issued by Northern Trust.

data.text: TORONTO--(BUSINESS WIRE)---- $TILT #NEOExchange--TILT Holdings Inc. (NEO:TILT), a global provider of cannabis business solutions, is now trading on NEO.

holdings.infoBox: TILT is an equity ETF with a total of 1915 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 5.45%, Apple at 4.94%, Microsoft at 3.89%, Alphabet at 3.70%, and Amazon.com at 2.51%.
